# dvgamerr.app

> The bilingual portfolio and resume of Kananek Thongkam (กัณฑ์อเนก ทองคำ, KEM, dvgamerr), a Technical Lead Software Engineer at WEDO (SCG Digital Office), the digital business arm of SCG (Siam Cement Group), based in Bangkok, Thailand.

The site is available in English and Thai. It covers professional experience (agentic AI, multi-agent systems, GitOps platforms), education, technical skills, coding activity, and public contact channels.

## Portfolio

- [English portfolio and resume](https://dvgamerr.app/index.md): Markdown version of the primary English-language profile.
- [Thai portfolio and resume](https://dvgamerr.app/th/index.md): Markdown version of the Thai-language profile.

## Profiles and source

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/dvgamerr): Public repositories and engineering activity.
- [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kananek-thongkam/): Professional profile.
- [dev.to profile](https://dev.to/dvgamerr): Technical writing.
- [WakaTime profile](https://wakatime.com/@dvgamerr): Coding activity statistics.
- [Portfolio source repository](https://github.com/dvgamerr-app/dvgamerr-app.github.io): Astro and Svelte source code for this website.
